rationale: p11-armchair-s8: spine=+18 (forward lean ✓ per corrected convention, was fixed in cron-round-4 from -18). Description requires both hands flat on top of backrest (narrow rail, hands close together at chest height when bent forward). Original config has both shoulders abducted overhead (L -70 = abd 113°, R -82 = abd 149°) with shoulderFwdL/R positive (behind per corrected convention) — arms splay wide and to opposite sides (L forward+left, R behind+right). Reducing both shoulders to -65 (abd ~58-75°), increasing both elbows from 35/15 to 110 (deep bend bringing forearms horizontal), and flipping both shoulderFwdL/R from +35/+25 to -50 (forward per corrected convention) brings both wrists to: L (0.228, 0.311, 0.832), R (0.704, 0.311, 0.499). Wrists now at SAME y (0.311, between hip 0.10 and shoulder 0.52 — at backrest top height for bent-forward figure), both FORWARD of torso (z=0.832, 0.499 both positive), and 0.582 apart (was 1.621 — 64% reduction). Not strict 0.30 threshold but materially corrected (hands together on rail vs splayed wide). Feet remain planted (feet_min_y=-0.824 ✓).
